questions.explanation: Confuses Instructions with Specifications; Instructions govern the bidding process, not construction methods. Wrongly assumes lowest bid guarantee; Instructions may specify that non-price factors (qualifications, schedule) are considered. Mischaracterizes the purpose as anticompetitive; Instructions are designed to ensure fair, transparent bidding. Instructions to Bidders establish binding rules governing the bidding process: bid format, required documentation, deadline, bid opening procedure, and evaluation criteria. Instructions to Bidders define the bidding rules—format, documentation, deadline, and evaluation criteria.

questions.explanation: Omits critical components; bid documents must include Instructions, Agreement, General Conditions, and Specifications for complete bidding. Reverses the process; Drawings and Specifications are both provided before bidding to enable accurate bids. Describes informal, non-competitive selection, not the structured formal bidding process with required documents. Bid documents comprise the complete package: Advertisement, Instructions to Bidders, proposed Agreement, General Conditions, Special Provisions, Drawings, Specifications, and supplemental schedules. Bid documents are a complete package including Advertisement, Instructions, Agreement, General Conditions, Drawings, Specifications, and schedules.
